annotations.title: Scan a web page for accessibility problems

description: Checks one public web page with automated accessibility tests (axe-core) and returns plain-English findings, worst first, each with why it matters and how to fix it. Notes which findings the free Fixlight WordPress plugin fixes on its own. Automated checks find many problems, but not all of them: a page with no findings here can still have barriers for some visitors, and this tool never scores or labels a site as a whole.

url.description: The public http(s) address of the page to check, for example https://example.com/

name: scan_url
